headline: Insulet (PODD) Is Down 21.9% After Cutting 2026 Revenue Outlook On Weaker Type 2 Retention
summary: In early August 2026, Insulet Corporation reported Q2 results showing US$801.7 million in sales and US$95.0 million in net income, then issued new guidance calling for total GAAP revenue growth of 17%–19% for Q3 2026 and 21%–23% for full-year 2026. At the same time, management cut full-year revenue expectations due to weaker-than-hoped retention and utilization among Type 2 diabetes users, despite strong overall Omnipod growth and higher international guidance.
